rejected.reason: Document: a table card with a QR code (text only, no visual value for the site)
Mislabelled: shows a seaside gazebo over the water, not pizza, and it is not clearly Kenny's
Duplicate of the main logo (smaller copy)
Entrance sign shows an older phone number (957-4032) that conflicts with the main number 876-912-3719
Heavy red colour cast and blurry; the other pizza photos are clearer

notes: Frame-grabs/*.jpg are stills from the supplied videos; the videos themselves are used, so the stills are reference only.
